When you request a clearance from the Accounting office at LSPU, you are actually applying for the Releasing of Clearance service.
The Releasing of Clearance service is available to all students.
The service is completely free of charge.
The service is designed to be completed in about 1 minute.
You must present your Student ID so your student number can be verified in the system.
You go to the Accounting office and present your ID to the staff, specifically an Aide VI.
The staff member checks the system to see if you have any unsettled accounts.
If you do have an outstanding balance, you will be directed to settle your accounts at the Cashier's Office first.
If you have no outstanding balance in the system, your clearance will be issued immediately.

The refund rule is from the Registrar’s policy on Final Examination: The Remaining Balance under the Graduate Studies section.
The policy covers the tuition fee paid upon enrolment when a student withdraws within the first 30 days after the date of registration.
If withdrawal is within the first week of registration, 80% of the amount paid is refunded, regardless of attendance.
If withdrawal is within the second, third, or fourth week after registration, 50% of the amount paid is refunded, regardless of attendance.
After registration, there is no refund for other fees.
The Leave of Absence policy does not include a refund amount for enrolment fees.
The policy does not contain a rule on Honorable Dismissal.
If the case is treated under the withdrawal refund rule, the refund would be 80% within the first week, 50% within weeks 2–4, or no refund for other fees after registration.

A student who is granted an Honorable Dismissal may not be readmitted in the university.
